definitions.explanation: Objects used for decoration or adornment, including jewelry, accessories, and decorative household items.

examples.japanese: {装飾品|そうしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装飾品|そうしょくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金|きん}や⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装飾品|そうしょくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This museum has many gold and silver ornaments on display.

notes:
USAGE:
{装飾品|そうしょくひん} is a broad term covering both personal adornments (jewelry, accessories) and decorative objects (ornamental items). It is more formal than ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧, which specifically refers to fashion accessories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {装飾品|そうしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧ (to wear accessories)
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧{装飾品|そうしょくひん} (metal ornaments)
- {装飾品|そうしょくひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (accessories department)
